summary.zh: dedupe 与 relocate 的预览新增影响面（impact）：退役或迁移前先按各客户端读取的文件位置算出谁会失去、保留或改读哪一份，符号链接悬空与「其他机器上的该项目不再带有它」写成警告；只多信息，不改写入语义，状态仍为 ready。
summary.en: dedupe and relocate previews gain an impact section: before retiring or moving a Skill or MCP entry they work out, from the file locations each client reads, who loses it, keeps it or reads a different copy; dangling symlinks and "projects on other machines no longer carry it" become warnings. Information only: writes are unchanged and the status stays ready.
